Account: `os-justin` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-24781-batch-empty-id-400`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-24781`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#2` (seat post #22648)
File surface (read on `origin/main` `a43405d59`; line numbers move; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts`, the cross-object `/batch` door's up-front id check (about `:206`). It reads `op.id == null && op.data?.id == null`, so an `update` / `delete` op whose id is the empty string passes it and reaches the engine, which throws. That throw answers `500` (`DATABASE_ERROR` for update, `INTERNAL_ERROR` for delete), where a missing id answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`.
- The fix makes a blank id answer exactly what a missing id answers today, with the same code and sentence, before any write. One rule serves both. Every other door that serves the same operation and has the same up-front check is measured: the per-object `/data/:object/batch` and the dispatcher's twin, if it has one. Where one shares the gap, it is fixed in the same rule and named in the PR body.
- Pins in `packages/rest` (next to `rest-batch-endpoint.test.ts`): `update` and `delete` with `"id": ""` answer `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` and write nothing. A missing id and a real id answer as before.
- A changeset for `@objectstack/rest` (patch).
- ⛔ Hold-offs: the engine's `Update requires an ID…` / `Delete requires…` throws and their error mapping, which are #24768's region of door parity (open, untriaged); `content/docs/references/api/batch.mdx`, which PR #24778 touches; `packages/spec/**`.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Basis for the Clause-② line: a request the door accepted into the engine (and answered `500`) is refused `400` up front. That narrows a public REST door's accept set and widens nothing. It owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record before the queue, and it stays in this lane.
Responsibility: this lane's REST door (`packages/rest`). No platform path covers it: the engine refuses the write but answers it as a server fault. It is reachable by any authenticated `/api/v1/batch` client, and it was measured on a stock showcase boot (card).
Thread-read: none
Main-red hold: this lane's main-red #24780 is open, so this card's PR does not arm the queue until #24780's row 1 lands.
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open PR touches `packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts` or its batch tests. All 18 open PRs were read in this act. PR #24789 touches three other `packages/rest/src/meta-*` tests, and PR #24778 touches `batch.mdx` (held off) and another `rest` test.
- This seat's cards in flight, #24738 (`plugin-hono-server`, CORS) and #24780 (a dogfood fixture), are disjoint. Seat 1 has no card in flight in this lane at this read.
- The open `pm:on-hold` cards' `Restart-touch:` lines (15 cards, 1 line: `scripts/test-shard-timings.json`) have no hit.
